_meta.description: Authored mission briefing and tutorial copy, owned by Member 2. This is static, editable game content with no AI/runtime dependency. Replace bracketed runtime tokens only in the presentation layer; the simulation remains authoritative for values and outcomes.

mission_briefing.title: PEAKS OF ETERNAL LIGHT
mission_briefing.subtitle: Lunar Outpost Mission Trainer
mission_briefing.opening: Commander, establish a lunar outpost and sustain your crew through a short operational mission. Every sol, power, life support, terrain, and human decisions must stay in balance.
mission_briefing.primary_objective: Keep the crew operational through Sol [MISSION_LENGTH].
mission_briefing.site_choice_prompt: Select a landing site. Compare illumination, terrain, and hydrogen-resource potential before you commit.
mission_briefing.science_notice: Site readings come from NASA-derived data where marked verified. Hydrogen signals indicate resource potential, not guaranteed extractable water.
mission_briefing.success_note: A mission is not won by one full meter. It is won by making trade-offs early enough to recover from them.

tutorial_steps.title: 1. Choose a site
tutorial_steps.body: High illumination helps solar generation. Terrain and hydrogen-resource potential create different opportunities and risks. Inspect the source status before treating a reading as certain.

tutorial_steps.title: 2. Read the reserves
tutorial_steps.body: Energy is stored in kWh. Water, oxygen, and food are survival reserves. A warning means you should change the plan before a reserve is depleted.

tutorial_steps.title: 3. Build with intent
tutorial_steps.body: Structures consume materials, construction energy, and time. Build for the mission's current constraint instead of trying to build everything at once.

tutorial_steps.title: 4. Use the rover carefully
tutorial_steps.body: Rover travel costs power and can uncover prospects. A hydrogen-rich signal is only the beginning: investigate it before planning extraction.

tutorial_steps.title: 5. Resolve events
tutorial_steps.body: Events present trade-offs, not trivia. Read each option, choose deliberately, and expect the consequence to affect later sols.

tutorial_steps.title: 6. Run the sol
tutorial_steps.body: Advance one sol to apply the mission model. Watch the changed reserves and active events, then adapt before running the next sol.
